notes: A delegated-authorisation chain longer than the maximum depth is unverifiable. T8 counts parent links from the cited grant to the root, so grant-depth-10 (citing depth-9) has a nine-link chain and is unverifiable E_GRANT_UNRESOLVED, while grant-depth-9 (citing depth-8, eight links) is still valid. The chain is built from distinct records (no digest cycles, which are impossible by construction).
